rule: The pins the paper evidence is resolved against. corpus_commit is the plectis-erdos-lean commit whose Challenge and Solution files the Comparator marks open; replay names the run that checked every linked entry at that commit, and receipts the directory holding that run's per-entry reports. record_commit is the default plectis-erdos commit holding the evidence records the rendered papers link to; record_commit_overrides selects a newer record commit for an individual paper.
